spans.s:
होतृ a. (त्री f.) [हु-तृच्]
Sacrificing, offering oblations with fire;
वहति विधिहुतं या हविर्या च होत्री
Ś. 1. 1. --m.
1 A sacrificial priest,
especially one who recites the
prayers of the Ṛgveda at a sacrifice.
--2 A sacrificer;
होतृकः An assistant of the Hotṛ.

होत्रं [हु-ष्ट्रन्]
1 Anything fit to be
offered as an oblation (as ghee).
--2 A burnt offering.
--3 A sacrifice.

होत्रिन् m. A sacrificing priest who
offers the oblations.

होत्रीय a. [होत्राय हितं होतुरिदं वा छ]
Belonging to an oblation.
--यः The
priest who offers oblations to gods.
--यं The sacrificial hall.
